evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this would only take within the next five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' but no explicit framing of 'quote you can depend on' and no clear wait for affirmation before moving to agenda.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after logistics probing had already begun: 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to address during this call today?' — customer raises piano concern immediately, rep follows up twice ('only the piano... it's not moving?') to clarify.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep digs into piano twice: 'Is it an upright piano?' then 'does it weigh less than 500?' Customer provides details; rep then explains ground-floor-to-ground-floor limitation.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (two-story house), floor/stories, bedrooms (2), walking distance (10 feet), additional room (one-car garage, full of items), special considerations (piano, ground-floor-only), second destination covered similarly — all seven items present.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'typically based on your home size that will be from 45 to 55 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' — asked directly.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep says 'And no need help, I packing this is from point eight to point B' — no clear packing services offer (transcription garbled, but no recognizable ask).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep anchors to home size and provides range: '6 to 7 hours, estimated cost would be $1,540' personalized to two-story-to-two-story move with 2 movers, 1 truck.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee, overnight fee, and packing materials not mentioned upfront. Rep does provide 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute-increment framing: 'minimum of two and a half hours... will always be prorated into fifteen minute, increment.' No-hidden-fees disclosure present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked 'Does that feel fair?' Rep pivots directly to October 9th availability.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Mentioned but vague: 'we still have on time guarantee' — no discount terms or 'discounting immediately if late' language.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Mentioned but incomplete: 'insurance coverage up to 2000 dollars remove' — missing explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing and no clarification that it's built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' asked; rep moves directly to availability.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final-concerns version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Asked plainly: 'Would you like our help with your move?' — no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Mentioned: 'no deposit required. No rest securing your spot. So, if something comes up or things change on your end then you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (October 9th, 8:00 AM slot confirmed), no explicit phone number confirmation stated, arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM mentioned, customer says '8:00 AM' without rep correcting), crew size (2 movers, 1 truck stated), addresses (both confirmed in probing), no notes left with crew about piano concern or customer worries.

top_strength: Rep thoroughly probed logistics details, uncovered the piano constraint, explained the ground-floor-to-ground-floor limitation clearly, and provided a well-anchored, personalized estimate with full pricing transparency.
coaching_note: Skip the empty 'Does that feel fair?' pause and add a genuine final-concerns check ('What's still concerning you?') before closing — the piano detail was handled well but needs explicit confirmation at the end that all worries are addressed.
